title: Shifts of explicit affine etale free complexes detect derived isomorphisms
statement: Let T be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and C any commutative ring. Work in the unbounded derived category D(T_et,C) of ModuleCat-valued sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For each object U of the small affine etale site, let F_U be the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the presheaf V ↦ ⊕_{a:V→Spec(U)} C, with restrictions induced by precomposition [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module], and let E_U=F_U[0]. If h:A→B is a derived morphism such that Hom(E_U[n],A)→Hom(E_U[n],B), φ↦φ≫h, is bijective for every affine etale U and every integer n, then h is an isomorphism. The objects E_U are the explicit sheafification-and-single-complex construction, with no choice from an existence theorem. There are no Noetherian, separatedness, coefficient-finiteness or compactness hypotheses.

proof.text: Free Yoneda identifies maps from the affine free sheaves with sections. Evaluation at 1 identifies maps from the coefficient module C with elements. The cover-dense affine etale inclusion detects equality of sheaf morphisms, so these ordinary free sheaves form a separating family. This uses Sheaf.freeYonedaHomEquiv and Functor.whiskerLeft_obj_map_bijective_of_isCoverDense directly.

proof.text: For any separating family G in an abelian category with K-injective resolutions, suppose Hom(G[0],K[n]) vanishes for all generators and integers n. Resolve K by a K-injective I. CochainComplex.IsKInjective.Qh_map_bijective and CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv transfer this vanishing to Hom-complex cohomology classes from each single complex to I. The proved source subsingleton_cohomologyClass_singleFunctor_iff says every map from G to cycles lifts through the preceding differential. To show the differential onto cycles is epi, test equality of two morphisms out of cycles on G and use each such lift. Thus I is exact at every degree. DerivedCategory.isZero_of_forall_isZero_homology implies K is zero. This argument is fully proved by the private helpers exact_of_classes and zero_of_tests.

proof.text: For h satisfying all shifted postcomposition bijections, shift adjunction transfers them to bijections on Hom(G[0],h[n]). Take a distinguished cone triangle A to B to K. Exactness of Hom out of G[0] on each shifted triangle, surjectivity for h[n], and injectivity for h[n+1] make every map to K[n] zero. The shifted triangle first map is (-1)^n times h[n]; the Lean proof explicitly cancels this unit and uses shiftFunctorAdd naturality to align the next degree. Apply the preceding zero-object criterion to K, then Triangle.isZero3_iff_isIso1 (Lean: isZero₃_iff_isIso₁) gives IsIso h. This is the proved private helper iso_of_tests.

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_of_affineEtaleFreeComplex
    (C : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing C] (T : Scheme.{u})
    {A B : DerivedCategoryModule C T} (h : A ⟶ B)
    (hh : ∀ (U : T.AffineEtale) (n : ℤ),
      Function.Bijective
        (fun (φ : (affineEtaleFreeComplex C T U)⟦n⟧ ⟶ A) ↦ φ ≫ h)) :
    IsIso h
